facts_snapshot.P3_latest_failure: At 18:31:30, about 21 seconds after the page reported the four-arm connection, right follower motor 7 returned DM error 0xC. The i2rt control thread stopped and the page disabled maintenance controls. The operator then requested page disconnect; all four robot objects reported zero-torque close and all four station CAN interfaces returned DOWN.
facts_snapshot.P3_diagnosis_reported_not_retested: The pinned i2rt PR #81 tree still contained the bug documented by upstream draft PR #82 commit e599e9d: startup +/-2pi encoder correction iterated over all seven motors. The right linear gripper's saved open endpoint is -5.03948 rad, so starting while open can spuriously change motor 7's offset by -2pi while retaining the old endpoints. A subsequent normalized hold target can therefore map about 1.17 rad beyond the physical open endpoint and sustain force at the stop.
facts_snapshot.P3_remediation_work_in_progress: Vendor the exact e599e9d correction as patches/i2rt/0002-exclude-gripper-wrap.patch, apply it during deployment, and fail closed in yam_adapter before opening hardware when the corrected helper is absent. Do not reactivate the right follower until it has cooled and the mechanism is checked for binding.
facts_snapshot.P3_latest_reported_tests_uncommitted: 270 tests passed, 2 skipped, 17 subtests passed; the upstream wrap regression passed against a temporary PR #81 tree with the vendored patch applied; Ruff and git diff checks passed.
